entry.title: New: dsh-skin-universe
entry.summary: Web GUI bundle for DSH: a task board with cron scheduling, a Git branch graph, a file and change side panel, an SSH terminal with SFTP and port forwarding, QR-paired mobile remote control, a desktop companion, live token statistics, and five installable themes. Exact install spec: github:springbrand-lab/dsh-skin-universe. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
